verdict.rationale: Stripe Invoicing documents a Dashboard export of all or a subset of invoices as CSV, plus per-invoice PDF and receipt downloads. The Invoicing API, official libraries and JSON webhooks offer a programmatic way to pull data out. Nothing shows a complete account-wide export or a documented exit path, so leaving with all data relies on building your own API extraction. Missing for 10: a documented full-account export covering customers, products, prices, credit notes and payments in open formats; offboarding or migration guidance; independent or hands-on confirmation that the exports are complete.
